caseNameFull: Hickman, Administrator v. Taylor, trading as Taylor & Anderson Towing & Lighterage Co.
attorneys: Abraham E. Freedman and Charles Lakatos for petitioner., Lee Pressman and Frank Donner filed a brief for the United Railroad Workers, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: The petition for rehearing is granted. The order of April 22 denying the petition for writ of certiorari, 327 U. S. 808, is vacated and the petition for writ of certiorari is granted.
